papers.reason: Lists categories of AI tools (Table 1) and names external AI reporting guidelines (CONSORT-AI, CLAIM, MINIMAR, etc.) but proposes no scheme of its own for classifying disclosure, attribution, or provenance of a produced work.

schemes.empirical_basis: 15 ofﬁcial policy documents from 10 major publishers and AI conference venues
